expectations.text: Frames TISAX correctly: ENX-governed assessment-and-label-exchange regime on the VDA ISA — an assessment with shareable labels, not a certification
expectations.evidence: "TISAX is an assessment with shareable labels, not a certification. It is run by the ENX Association on behalf of the VDA" against the ISA catalogue.

expectations.text: Describes the process: ENX portal registration → scope definition (standard scope recommended) → accredited audit provider → assessment at the level your objectives require (AL2 plausibility check vs AL3 on-site) → labels shared via the platform
expectations.evidence: "Register on the ENX portal... Use the standard scope, which is strongly recommended... Select an ENX-accredited audit provider... AL2 (audit provider plausibility check, usually remote)... AL3 (comprehensive on-site)... share results with customers on the ENX platform."

expectations.text: States fees accurately: ~€405 net per location and scope (assessment-based) or the €5,000/year participation option, plus audit-provider costs
expectations.evidence: "€405 net per location and scope (one-time...), or €5,000 per year for Participation Based Charges"; "Audit provider fees: these are separate... usually the largest external cost."

expectations.text: Covers the corrective mechanics: nonconformities → corrective action plan, temporary labels, follow-up within the 9-month window; labels valid 3 years
expectations.evidence: "you submit a corrective action plan, may receive temporary labels, and have a follow-up assessment within the 9-month corrective window"; "Labels are valid for 3 years."

expectations.text: Flags the version decision for a first-timer NOW: order by December 31 for ISA 6 (open by March 2027) or plan directly against ISA2027
expectations.evidence: "ISA 6... ordered through December 31, 2026. ISA2027 applies to orders from January 1, 2027. An initial ISA-6 assessment must open by March 2027... build your gap assessment against ISA2027."
